1. On your phone, open %1$s (or point the camera at the code on the right).
2. Sign in with a Google account that is on this TV and type:

%2$s

3. Allow access to Google Drive. The TV only sees the files it creates itself (the OneTV-backup folder), never the rest of your Drive.

This screen continues by itself.
Done: %1$s is connected. Choose \"Google Drive\" in the Extra copy line so the nightly backup also goes there.

Google sign-in is not set up on this TV yet.\n\nSet it up in the web panel > Claude tab (your own OAuth client, \"TVs and Limited Input devices\" type), turn on the Google Drive API in the same Google Cloud project and come back here.
Disconnect %1$s? The copies already in Google Drive stay there; the TV stops sending new ones.
Connect the Google Drive account first (line above).
There are no copies in the OneTV-backup folder of Google Drive yet.
Wrong backup password (or the file was changed). Nothing was restored.
Restored. The launcher restarts in a moment.
